mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, name, email, phone, role_code, status_code, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT user_id, login_id, password, name, email, phone, role_code, status_code, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, password, name, email, phone, role_code, status_code) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{roleCode}, #{statusCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET status_code = #{statusCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
